thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — Customer Atlas asked for an end-of-quarter private deploy with an SLA: 99.9% availability and <150ms p95 for chat endpoints.

We need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security on scope and sequencing. High-level asks: dedicated capacity, KMS integration, audit logs, and a canary rollout path. who can take ownership of tradeoffs?

Maya: @Alex I can own the SLA write-up and rollout plan. need confirmation on capacity shape (burst vs steady) from runtime. :white_check_mark:

Sam: @Maya I can run a quick perf sweep on the candidate model variants. two questions: expected qps and avg prompt length? those drive batching/kv cache config.

Alex: avg qps ~ 120 steady with 400 bursts during peak onboarding. prompt length avg ~ 200 tokens, worst-case 1k.

Jordan: from infra side — we can provision a dedicated pool, but prewarm time matters. if runtime needs <10s cold-start we can do prewarmed nodes; otherwise we'll need standby capacity which costs more.

Priya: security checklist: KMS + HSM option, VPC peering, and audit log retention policy (90d default, enterprise wants 1yr). Also need threat model signoff before private control-plane access.

Sam: quick note on perf: with avg=200 tokens, p95 looks achievable with 8xA100-equivalent for the model; bursts will require autoscale policy with fast scale-up (ideally <60s). we should test continuous-batching thresholds.

Maya: proposed rollout (draft):
1) Contract gating: sign privacy addendum and scope doc.
2) Staging validation: perf + security checklist (2 weeks)
3) Canary (5% traffic to dedicated pool, monitor p95/error rate for 72h)
4) Progressive ramp (5x -> 25x -> 100x) with rollback windows.

Jordan: infra action items:
- estimate cost delta for standby vs rapid scale-up (by EOD Thu)
- reserve staging cluster and prewarm slots for canary

Priya: security action items:
- KMS integration plan + responsible owner (Priya)
- Threat model deliverable by next Tue
- Define audit retention SLA (ask legal for compliance requirement)

Alex: ok good. owners: Maya (rollout / product), Sam (perf tests), Jordan (infra provisioning), Priya (security/KMS).

Can each owner drop a short checklist in this thread by EOD tomorrow? keep it lightweight — just 3–5 bullets. I'll consolidate and share with Atlas.

deploy-bot: staging cluster "atlas-staging-1749" created by Jordan at 2024-11-15T15:42:00Z — 4 prewarm slots allocated. :rocket:

Sam: I'll post a perf test matrix later today. initial hypothesis: baseline quantized model + 8 GPUs = target p95, will validate. :eyes:

Maya: thanks team. if anyone sees blocker (policy/regulatory) that prevents private control plane, flag here immediately. otherwise i'll draft the contract gating checklist and ping legal. :handshake:
